name: Sesame-Ginger Orzo Pasta Salad with Shrimp, Carrot & Bell Pepper

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and orzo, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, about 8 minutes. Drain and rinse under cold water to cool. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g orzo pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
3 medium carrots
1 small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 ½ English cucumbers
3 red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger. Place in a large bowl along with soy sauce, vinegar, oil, sesame seeds, honey, and spices. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup soy sauce
⅓ cup rice vinegar
3 tbsp toasted sesame oil
3 tbsp sesame seeds
2 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel, trim, and coarsely grate carrots. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Trim, seed, and small dice bell peppers. Add to the bowl and set aside.
Preheat large skillet over medium-high heat.

While the skillet heats up, if using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 1.02 kg raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shrimp, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until just opaque, 3-4 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp toasted sesame oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, add cooled orzo to the bowl with the veggies and dressing. Stir to combine the salad.
To serve, divide orzo pasta salad between plates or bowls. Top with shrimp and enjoy!

line_items.ingredient_name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen
